expectations.text: States WCAG 2.0 Level AA, incorporated by the 2017 Revised 508 Standards
expectations.evidence: "Section 508 incorporates WCAG 2.0, Level A and AA" via "The Revised Section 508 Standards... (36 CFR Part 1194; 82 FR 5790, January 18, 2017)"

expectations.text: States it is not changing soon: no rulemaking is under way as of November 2026
expectations.evidence: "As of November 2026 that isn't changing soon" and "No refresh rulemaking is under way as of November 2026"

expectations.text: Notes the October 2026 refresh-NPRM reports are erroneous, tracing to the 2015 proposal
expectations.evidence: "reports in 2026 of a new Access Board ICT proposed rule. Those trace back to the 2015 proposed rule (80 FR 10880) and are not supported by the Federal Register record"

expectations.text: Notes agencies may voluntarily exceed the baseline (WCAG 2.1/2.2) but the legal floor remains 2.0 AA
expectations.evidence: "Many organizations test against 2.1 AA as well. That's a good hedge, but it is a best practice and not a 508 requirement"; baseline stays WCAG 2.0 AA

expectations.text: Distinguishes the adjacent DOJ and HHS rules that use WCAG 2.1 AA for different covered entities
expectations.evidence: "the DOJ ADA Title II web rule, for state and local governments" and "the HHS Section 504 web rule, for HHS-funded entities" — both use WCAG 2.1 AA, "Neither changes Section 508"
